				add = 10
				FROM = { original_tag = Y16 }
				check_variable = { zin_east_lean < -89.99 }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				FROM = { original_tag = Y14 }
				check_variable = { zin_east_lean > 99.99 }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				FROM = { original_tag = Y16 }
				check_variable = { zin_east_lean < -99.99 }
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 20
				is_neighbor_of = FROM
			}
			modifier = {
				add = -30
				OR = {
					AND = {
						FROM = { original_tag = Y14 }
						any_neighbor_country = { original_tag = Y16 }
					}
					AND = {
						FROM = { original_tag = Y16 }
						any_neighbor_country = { original_tag = Y14 }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		set_variable = { global.zin_east_invite_result = 1 }
		FROM = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_in_faction = no
					has_country_flag = zin_east_free_crowns_leader
				}
				create_faction_from_template = zin_faction_free_crowns
			}
			add_to_faction = ROOT
			country_event = { id = zin_east.72 }
		}
	}
}
